subject: general
question: Ram gave a discount of 10% on the marked price of an item and still gained 12.5%. How much would have Ram gained, if he sold the item at the marked price?
solution:
Given:

Ram gave a discount of 10% on the marked price of an item and still gained 12.5%.

Concept used:

Gain percentage = {(Selling Price - Cost Price) over Cost Price} times 100\%

Selling Price = Cost Price × (1 + Gain%)

Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 - Discount%)

Calculation:

Let the marked price be Rs. 100Q.

Hence,

Selling price = 100Q × 0.9 = Rs. 90Q

;Cost Price = 90Q ÷ 1.125 = 80Q

If he sold the item at marked price,

Gain% = {{100Q - 80Q} over 80Q} times 100\% = 25%

∴ Ram would have gained 25%.
